summary: Ran end-to-end tests of the Services Phase-1 frontend wired to the backend, using cookies set on the preview domain. Accounts: Empresa svc_smoke_empresa, Admin svc_smoke_admin, VIP muni_smoke_vip. All 7 requested flows passed. (1) Company create (title, category limpieza, modality domicilio, fixed price 30, window Miércoles 10:00-14:30, Saldo USDT, zone) gave status Pendiente, and it was saved correctly in the DB. (2) An empty price showed an error toast and the dialog stayed open. Choosing 'A presupuestar' hid the price field and the submit went through. (3) 'Guardar borrador' gave Borrador with a submit icon, and clicking it gave Pendiente. (4) Admin: pending filter, Ver detail (availability 'Mié: 10:00–14:30' and 'Pago: Saldo USDT' shown), approve moved it to Publicado. (5) Reject with reason gave Rechazado with the reason shown to the company; editing and saving re-submitted it as Pendiente and cleared the reason. (6) Category add, toggle off and on, and delete all worked; a duplicate name showed an error toast. (7) VIP marketplace: Servicios tab showed the approved card. Category chips, modality chips (remoto gave the empty message) and search all filter correctly. The detail dialog showed price, availability, a disabled Reservar button and the próximamente note. New backend regression file: 10/10 passing. All test services and categories were cleaned up.

critical.issue: Moderation bypass: editing a PUBLISHED service (title, price, description, images) keeps status=published and is_active=true, so the change goes live with no staff re-approval. Confirmed by test_edit_published_stays_published_without_review. Suggested fix: when status is published (or always, for content fields) set status=pending or keep a pending_changes copy, and notify admins.

minor.issue: No frontend route /admin/services exists in AdminPanel.jsx (services live under /admin/products), so the admin notification deep-link leads nowhere. Change to '/admin/products'.
Does not check the current status: admin can approve a DRAFT the company never submitted (the UI shows the approve button on the Borrador tab too). Restrict to pending (or pending/rejected).
category is not checked against existing active categories (any string is accepted). Availability start/end are not checked for HH:MM format or start<end. blocked_dates format is not checked.
No status guard. pause on a pending/draft service sets is_active=false, which approve then silently overrides.

integration_issues.issue: ServicesMarketplace fetches /services only on mount and does not subscribe to the services_changed live-bus event, so newly approved or paused services do not appear until reload.

issues: Page header still reads 'Canjea por Mercancía' while the Servicios tab is active
All services strings are hardcoded Spanish and ignore the EN language toggle
Admin UI is in English (VIP vendor products, PENDING...) but the services section and categories block are hardcoded Spanish (no i18n)
The status badge never shows 'Pausado' for paused published services (effStatus is used only in the company view)
Blocked dates use a native <input type=date> and the weekday uses a native <select>, while every other picker uses shadcn Select. Consider the shadcn Calendar/Popover for consistency

action_items: HIGH: In PUT /api/company/services/{id}, send edits of a published service back to review (status=pending + notify admins), or store pending_changes, so edits cannot skip moderation
Restrict admin approve to pending/rejected services; hide the approve button on Borrador cards
Validate category slug against active categories, and availability HH:MM with start<end
Optional: subscribe ServicesMarketplace to the services_changed live event; adjust the marketplace header for the Servicios tab; add i18n
critical_code_review_comments: routes/services.py update_my_service: published content is mutable without moderation
routes/services.py pause/unpause and approve lack state-machine guards
ServicesMarketplace.jsx line 77: `(usedCategories.length > 0 || true)` is dead logic
Frontend files are all under 500 lines; data-testids are complete for all tested elements
